results.title: AI-skilled job postings more than double in Q1 FY27 as demand spreads beyond tech roles: Report
results.description: Bengaluru (Karnataka) [India]: Job postings seeking artificial intelligence skills more than doubled in India during the first quarter of Financial Year (FY)27, with demand increasingly spreading beyond specialist technology positions into roles such as digital marketing, graphic design, business development and teaching. Postings asking for AI skills grew 112.4 per cent year-on-year during the quarter, [...] ChiniMandi
